description: User-specific tab permissions configuration. This allows overriding role-based permissions for individual users.

john_doe.description: User with access to only Complaints and Complaints Analytics

jane_smith.description: User with access to Dashboard, Complaints and Complaints Analytics

labtech.description: User with access to complaintsAnalytics, complaints

labTech2.description: User with access to complaints, complaintsAnalytics

manager.description: User with access to complaints, complaintsAnalytics

how_to_use: 1. Add a new user entry in the 'users' object
2. Set 'allowedTabs' array with the tab keys they should access
3. Available tab keys: dashboard, samples, tests, results, complaints, complaintsAnalytics, userManagement, clinicalTrials, clinicalSample
4. Update the tabPermissions.js file to import and use this configuration
